articles.summary: H&P received the Leadership Giving Award at the 2025 Live United Awards on Feb. 25, 2026, recognizing the company’s commitment to community investment and its model leadership giving program. The award honors organizations that establish strong leadership giving programs, defined as annual gifts of $600 or more, often supported by incentives, leadership engagement and internal recognition.
